```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dpi = 600,
  out.width = "100%",
  fig.width = 7.5,
  fig.height = 4.5,
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
library(ggplot2)
library(flextable)

# ---------------- Saved results (read-only) ----------------
result_files <- c("final_evaluation_results.rds", "explain_shap_main.rds",
                  "explain_shap_stability.rds", "explain_lime_and_summary.rds",
                  "explain_ann_decomposition.rds", "model_selection_locked.rds",
                  "ann_selection_locked.rds")
missing_files <- result_files[!file.exists(result_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("Missing results files in ", getwd(), ": ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "))
}
ev       <- readRDS("final_evaluation_results.rds")
shp      <- readRDS("explain_shap_main.rds")
stab     <- readRDS("explain_shap_stability.rds")
lm_      <- readRDS("explain_lime_and_summary.rds")
dec      <- readRDS("explain_ann_decomposition.rds")
gbm_lock <- readRDS("model_selection_locked.rds")   # grouped GBM grid and the two locked choices
ann_lock <- readRDS("ann_selection_locked.rds")     # ANN grid and the two locked choices
has_ungrouped <- file.exists("gbm_grid_ungrouped.rds")   # optional leakage comparison

# ---------------- Colours (regional claims map) ----------------
map_low    <- "#E0F7FA"
map_high   <- "#0288D1"
map_na     <- "#ECEFF1"
blue_dark  <- "#01579B"
blue_mid   <- map_high
blue_light <- "#B3E5FC"
blue_grid  <- map_na

# ---------------- Model labels, colours, shapes ----------------
model_order  <- c("GLM", "GBM_selected", "GBM_sensitivity", "ANN_selected", "ANN_sensitivity")
model_labels <- c(GLM = "GLM", GBM_selected = "GBM (selected)", GBM_sensitivity = "GBM (sensitivity)",
                  ANN_selected = "ANN (selected)", ANN_sensitivity = "ANN (sensitivity)")
pal    <- c("GLM" = blue_dark, "GBM (selected)" = blue_mid, "GBM (sensitivity)" = "#4FC3F7",
            "ANN (selected)" = "#00838F", "ANN (sensitivity)" = "#80DEEA")
shapes <- c("GLM" = 16, "GBM (selected)" = 17, "GBM (sensitivity)" = 2,
            "ANN (selected)" = 15, "ANN (sensitivity)" = 0)
ltypes <- c("GLM" = "solid", "GBM (selected)" = "solid", "GBM (sensitivity)" = "dashed",
            "ANN (selected)" = "solid", "ANN (sensitivity)" = "dashed")
lab <- function(x) factor(unname(model_labels[as.character(x)]), levels = unname(model_labels))

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = blue_grid),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = blue_dark, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey25"))
scale_model <- function() list(scale_colour_manual(values = pal),
                               scale_shape_manual(values = shapes),
                               scale_linetype_manual(values = ltypes))

# ---------------- Table theme ----------------
tbl_size <- 12   # the brief asks for Arial 12 throughout
themed_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, align = NULL, size = tbl_size) {
  ft <- flextable(df)
  ft <- font(ft, fontname = "Arial", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = size, part = "all")
  ft <- bg(ft, bg = map_high, part = "header")
  ft <- color(ft, color = "white", part = "header")
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  if (nrow(df) >= 2) ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), by = 2), bg = map_low, part = "body")
  ft <- border_remove(ft)
  ft <- hline(ft, border = officer::fp_border(color = map_na, width = 1), part = "body")
  ft <- hline_bottom(ft, border = officer::fp_border(color = blue_dark, width = 1.5), part = "body")
  if (!is.null(align)) {
    al <- c(l = "left", c = "center", r = "right")[strsplit(align, "")[[1]]]
    for (k in seq_along(al)) ft <- align(ft, j = k, align = unname(al[k]), part = "all")
  }
  if (!is.null(caption)) ft <- set_caption(ft, caption = caption)
  ft <- autofit(ft)
  set_table_properties(ft, layout = "autofit", width = 1)   # fit the page width; cells wrap
}

# ---------------- Formatting helpers ----------------
fmt      <- function(x, d = 4) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
fmt_na   <- function(x, d = 3) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", fmt(x, d))
sci      <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2)
pct      <- function(sd) 100 * (exp(sd) - 1)                 # SD in log units -> premium-equivalent %
sd_pct   <- function(sd) sprintf("%.4f (%.1f%%)", sd, pct(sd))
order_models <- function(df, col = "model") df[order(match(df[[col]], model_order)), ]

# LIME binning schemes (names as saved, or as C / A / D)
scheme_labels <- c(prespecified_bins = "Fixed bins (primary)", C = "Fixed bins (primary)",
                   default_lime_bins = "Default bins",         A = "Default bins",
                   no_bins = "No binning",                     D = "No binning")
scheme_levels <- c("Fixed bins (primary)", "Default bins", "No binning")
relabel_scheme <- function(x) {
  out <- unname(scheme_labels[as.character(x)])
  out[is.na(out)] <- as.character(x)[is.na(out)]
  factor(out, levels = unique(c(scheme_levels, out)))
}
```

# Appendix A: Accuracy

GBM tuning grid on grouped cross-validation folds. Ordered by Poisson Negative Log Likelihood, lower NLL is better. Leaves per tree, `num_leaves` and minimum leaf size, `min_data_in_leaf` are varied with no depth limit. Trees are the early-stopping optimum. CV SE is the standard error across folds. 

```{r tab-gbm-grid}
g   <- gbm_lock$grid
if (is.null(g$total_leaves)) g$total_leaves <- g$num_leaves * g$best_trees
g   <- g[order(g$valid_nll), ]
sel <- gbm_lock$selected; sen <- gbm_lock$sensitivity
role <- ifelse(g$num_leaves == sel$num_leaves & g$min_data_in_leaf == sel$min_data_in_leaf, "Selected",
         ifelse(g$num_leaves == sen$num_leaves & g$min_data_in_leaf == sen$min_data_in_leaf, "Sensitivity", ""))
themed_table(
  data.frame(Rank = seq_len(nrow(g)), Role = role,
             `Leaves per tree` = g$num_leaves, `Minimum leaf size` = g$min_data_in_leaf,
             Trees = g$best_trees, `Total leaves` = format(g$total_leaves, big.mark = ","),
             `CV NLL` = fmt(g$valid_nll, 5), `CV SE` = fmt(g$valid_se, 5), check.names = FALSE),
  align = "rlrrrrrr",
  caption = paste("Gradient-boosted model tuning grid"))
```

Cross-validated NLL over the GBM grid for grouped (left) and ungrouped (right) folds. Deeper blue indicates higher loss (worse), the black outline indicates the selected and sensitivity configurations. 

```{r fig-gbm-heatmap, fig.height = 4.5}
gh <- gbm_lock$grid[, c("num_leaves", "min_data_in_leaf", "valid_nll")]
gh$folds <- "Grouped folds"
if (has_ungrouped) {
  ug <- readRDS("gbm_grid_ungrouped.rds")[, c("num_leaves", "min_data_in_leaf", "valid_nll")]
  ug$folds <- "Ungrouped folds"
  gh <- rbind(gh, ug)
}
gh$txt <- ifelse(gh$valid_nll > median(gh$valid_nll), "white", blue_dark)
gh$num_leaves       <- factor(gh$num_leaves)
gh$min_data_in_leaf <- factor(gh$min_data_in_leaf)
mark <- rbind(gbm_lock$selected[, c("num_leaves", "min_data_in_leaf")],
              gbm_lock$sensitivity[, c("num_leaves", "min_data_in_leaf")])
mark$folds <- "Grouped folds"
mark$num_leaves       <- factor(mark$num_leaves, levels = levels(gh$num_leaves))
mark$min_data_in_leaf <- factor(mark$min_data_in_leaf, levels = levels(gh$min_data_in_leaf))
ggplot(gh, aes(x = min_data_in_leaf, y = num_leaves)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = valid_nll), colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.4f", valid_nll), colour = txt), size = 2.4) +
  geom_tile(data = mark, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ folds) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = map_low, high = map_high, na.value = map_na, name = "CV NLL") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(x = "Minimum observations per leaf", y = "Leaves per tree") +
  base_theme + theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid = element_blank())
```
ANN tuning grid on grouped cross-validation folds (four architectures by two L2 penalties), ordered by cross-validated Poisson loss (lower is better). Parameters are trainable weights. Epochs are median early-stopping optimum across folds. 

```{r tab-ann-grid}
ga <- ann_lock$grid[order(ann_lock$grid$cv_loss), ]
units_of <- vapply(ann_lock$archs, paste, character(1), collapse = "-")
role_a <- ifelse(ga$arch == ann_lock$selected$arch & ga$l2 == ann_lock$selected$l2, "Selected",
           ifelse(ga$arch == ann_lock$sensitivity$arch & ga$l2 == ann_lock$sensitivity$l2, "Sensitivity", ""))
themed_table(
  data.frame(Rank = seq_len(nrow(ga)), Role = role_a, Architecture = ga$arch,
             `Hidden units` = unname(units_of[ga$arch]),
             `L2 penalty` = ifelse(ga$l2 == 0, "none", format(ga$l2, scientific = TRUE)),
             Parameters = format(ga$n_params, big.mark = ","),
             `CV loss` = fmt(ga$cv_loss, 5), `CV SE` = fmt(ga$cv_se, 5),
             `Median epochs` = ga$median_epoch, check.names = FALSE),
  align = "rllllrrrr",
  caption = paste("Table A2. ANN Tuning Grid"))
```
CV Loss over ANN grid (architecture by L2 penalty). Deeper blue indicates higher loss (worse) and the black outline marks the selected and sensitivity configuration. 

```{r fig-ann-heatmap, fig.height = 3.5}
gg <- ann_lock$grid[, c("arch", "l2", "n_params", "cv_loss")]
gg$arch_lab <- paste0(gg$arch, " (", format(gg$n_params, big.mark = ","), " parameters)")
gg$arch_lab <- factor(gg$arch_lab, levels = unique(gg$arch_lab[order(gg$n_params)]))
gg$l2_lab   <- factor(ifelse(gg$l2 == 0, "none", format(gg$l2, scientific = TRUE)))
gg$txt      <- ifelse(gg$cv_loss > median(gg$cv_loss), "white", blue_dark)
mark_a <- rbind(ann_lock$selected[, c("arch", "l2")], ann_lock$sensitivity[, c("arch", "l2")])
mark_a$arch_lab <- factor(gg$arch_lab[match(mark_a$arch, gg$arch)], levels = levels(gg$arch_lab))
mark_a$l2_lab   <- factor(ifelse(mark_a$l2 == 0, "none", format(mark_a$l2, scientific = TRUE)),
                          levels = levels(gg$l2_lab))
ggplot(gg, aes(x = l2_lab, y = arch_lab)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = cv_loss), colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.5f", cv_loss), colour = txt), size = 3) +
  geom_tile(data = mark_a, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = map_low, high = map_high, na.value = map_na, name = "CV loss") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(x = "L2 penalty", y = "Architecture") +
  base_theme + theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid = element_blank())
```
Test deviance and calibration (predicted over observed claims) with 95% confidence interval, from a bootstrap of 2000 resamples of covariate-profile groups in the test set. 

```{r tab-intervals}

themed_table(

             `Deviance (95% CI)`    = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f, %.4f)", ci$deviance, ci$dev_lo, ci$dev_hi),
             `Calibration (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", ci$calibration, ci$cal_lo, ci$cal_hi),
             check.names = FALSE),
  align = "lrr",
  caption = paste("Test Deviance and Calibration"))
```


# Appendix B: Explainability

Validation of the exact SHAP computation: largest absolute efficiency error is checked for every model over the 300 explained policies by verifying that the attributions sum to the prediction minus the baseline and the largest absolute difference from the shapr implementation of KernelSHAP on 10 policies (log-frequency units). This validates the exact SHAP computation. 

```{r tab-pipeline}
eff <- shp$efficiency_error
checks <- data.frame(
  Check = paste("Efficiency:", as.character(lab(names(eff)))),
  `Largest absolute error` = sci(eff), check.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(shp$shapr_max_diff)) {
  checks <- rbind(checks, data.frame(
    Check = "Agreement with shapr: GBM (selected), 10 policies",
    `Largest absolute error` = sci(shp$shapr_max_diff), check.names = FALSE))
}
themed_table(checks, align = "lr",
  caption = paste("Validation of the exact SHAP computation"))
```
SHAP fidelity averaged over 300 explained test policies by the faithfulness correlation between the summed attributions of a feature subset and the change in the prediction when those features are removed, its standard error across policies, and the RMSE of the same comparison.

```{r tab-fidelity}
fi <- order_models(shp$shap_faith_summary)
themed_table(
  data.frame(Model = as.character(lab(fi$model)),
             `Mean fidelity correlation` = fmt(fi$faith_cor, 3),
             `Correlation SE` = fmt(fi$faith_cor_se, 3),
             `Mean RMSE (log units)` = fmt(fi$faith_rmse, 4),
             `RMSE as % of frequency` = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct(fi$faith_rmse)),
             check.names = FALSE),
  align = "lrrrr",
  caption = paste("SHAP fidelity"))
```
SHAP fidelity correlation with 95% intervals (left) and fidelity RMSE with its equivalent percentage of frequency (right) by model

```{r fig-fidelity-contrast, fig.height = 3.8, fig.cap = "SHAP fidelity correlation and fidelity RMSE"}
fid <- shp$shap_faith_summary
fid$lab <- lab(fid$model)
long <- rbind(
  data.frame(lab = fid$lab, metric = "Fidelity correlation (1 = perfect)", value = fid$faith_cor,
             lo = fid$faith_cor - 1.96 * fid$faith_cor_se,
             hi = pmin(1, fid$faith_cor + 1.96 * fid$faith_cor_se),
             label = sprintf("%.3f", fid$faith_cor)),
  data.frame(lab = fid$lab, metric = "Fidelity RMSE (log units; 0 = perfect)", value = fid$faith_rmse,
             lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_,
             label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct(fid$faith_rmse))))
long$metric <- factor(long$metric, levels = unique(long$metric))
axis_range <- data.frame(metric = factor(rep(levels(long$metric), each = 2), levels = levels(long$metric)),
                         lab = fid$lab[1],
                         value = c(0, 1, 0, 1.25 * max(fid$faith_rmse)))
ggplot(long, aes(x = lab, y = value, colour = lab, shape = lab)) +
  geom_blank(data = axis_range) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -1.1, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_model() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme + theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```
SHAP fidelity correlation by predicted-risk decile (1 is the lowest) and model

# Appendix C: Robustness

```{r robustness-helpers}
models_b <- c("GLM", "GBM_selected", "ANN_selected")
arr_of   <- function(l) array(unlist(l), dim = c(nrow(l[[1]]), ncol(l[[1]]), length(l)),
                              dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(l[[1]]), NULL))   # policy x feature x replicate
cell_var <- function(l) apply(arr_of(l), c(1, 2), var)                         # variance across replicates
rms_sd   <- function(l) sqrt(mean(cell_var(l)))                                # variance basis: sources add
ix1 <- match(models_b, stab$stab_axis1$model)
ix2 <- match(models_b, stab$stab_axis2$model)

# Silent integrity check: saved columns equal values recomputed from the raw attribution arrays
check <- data.frame(
  floor_saved      = stab$stab_axis1$mean_sd_phi[ix1],
  floor_recomputed = sapply(models_b, function(m) mean(apply(arr_of(stab$noise_phi[[m]]), c(1, 2), sd))),
  refit_saved      = stab$stab_axis2$mean_sd_phi[ix2],
  refit_recomputed = sapply(models_b, function(m) mean(apply(arr_of(stab$phi_refit[[m]]), c(1, 2), sd))),
  pred_sd_saved      = stab$stab_axis2$pred_sd[ix2],
  pred_sd_recomputed = sapply(models_b, function(m) mean(apply(do.call(cbind, stab$fx_refit[[m]]), 1, sd))))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(check$floor_saved, unname(check$floor_recomputed))),
          isTRUE(all.equal(check$refit_saved, unname(check$refit_recomputed))),
          isTRUE(all.equal(check$pred_sd_saved, unname(check$pred_sd_recomputed))))
```

Explainer-noise floor

```{r tab-floor}
f1 <- order_models(stab$stab_axis1)
themed_table(
  data.frame(Model = as.character(lab(f1$model)),
             `SD of attribution (log units)` = fmt(f1$mean_sd_phi, 4),
             `Premium-equivalent (%)`        = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * f1$premium_equiv),
             `Profile distance`              = fmt(f1$profile_tv, 3),
             `Local rank correlation`        = fmt(f1$local_rank_cor, 3),
             `Sign agreement`                = fmt(f1$sign_agreement, 3),
             check.names = FALSE),
  align = "lrrrrr",
  caption = sprintf(paste("Explainer-noise floor: each fitted model explained %d times with different 50-row",
                          "background samples, for the same 100 policies (SHAP). The floor depends on the background",
                          "size."), f1$R[1]))
```
Stability of SHAP attributions under refitting on 30 grouped bootstrap resamples (size of variation). SD is the standard deviation of an attribution across refits in log units with its premium-equivalent. Relative SD divides by the mean absolute attribution. Profile distance measures reallocation between features (0 = identical). Prediction SD is the standard deviation of the log-prediction across refits.
```{r tab-refit-size}
f2 <- order_models(stab$stab_axis2)
themed_table(
  data.frame(Model = as.character(lab(f2$model)),
             `SD of attribution (log units)` = fmt(f2$mean_sd_phi, 4),
             `Premium-equivalent (%)`        = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * f2$premium_equiv),
             `Relative SD`                   = fmt(f2$rel_sd, 3),
             `Profile distance`              = fmt(f2$profile_tv, 3),
             `Prediction SD (log units)`     = fmt(f2$pred_sd, 3),
             check.names = FALSE),
  align = "lrrrrr",
  caption = paste("Stability of SHAP attributions"))
```
Stability of SHAP attributions under refitting: ranking and direction. Local and global rank correlations compare feature rankings per policy and overall across refits; top-3 overlap is the share of the three most important features shared between refits. Sign agreement is the share of refits agreeing in direction for material contributions.

```{r tab-refit-rank}
themed_table(
  data.frame(Model = as.character(lab(f2$model)),
             `Local rank correlation`  = fmt(f2$local_rank_cor, 3),
             `Global rank correlation` = fmt(f2$global_rank_cor, 3),
             `Top-3 overlap`           = fmt(f2$top3_overlap, 3),
             `Sign agreement`          = fmt(f2$sign_agreement, 3),
             check.names = FALSE),
  align = "lrrrr",
  caption = paste("Stability of SHAP attributions under refitting: ranking and direction."))
```
Sources of variation in a feature's SHAP attribution: SD in log units (premium-equivalent).Explainer noise comes from a separate experiment and is not part of the refit total (the refits use a fixed background). Root-mean-square basis, so the seed and data parts add as variances.

```{r tab-sources}
noise_rms <- sapply(models_b, function(m) rms_sd(stab$noise_phi[[m]]))
refit_rms <- sapply(models_b, function(m) rms_sd(stab$phi_refit[[m]]))
seed_rms  <- rms_sd(dec$seed_phi)                                   # five final ANNs, same background
stopifnot(abs(seed_rms^2 / refit_rms[["ANN_selected"]]^2 - dec$seed_share) < 1e-6)
data_rms  <- c(refit_rms[["GLM"]], refit_rms[["GBM_selected"]],
               sqrt(refit_rms[["ANN_selected"]]^2 - seed_rms^2))
sources <- data.frame(
  Source = c("Explainer noise (50-row background draw)", "Training seed (ANN only)",
             "Data sensitivity (refit on resampled data)", "Total under refits"),
  GLM = c(sd_pct(noise_rms[["GLM"]]), "–", sd_pct(data_rms[1]), sd_pct(refit_rms[["GLM"]])),
  GBM = c(sd_pct(noise_rms[["GBM_selected"]]), "–", sd_pct(data_rms[2]), sd_pct(refit_rms[["GBM_selected"]])),
  ANN = c(sd_pct(noise_rms[["ANN_selected"]]), sd_pct(seed_rms), sd_pct(data_rms[3]),
          sd_pct(refit_rms[["ANN_selected"]])),
  check.names = FALSE)
themed_table(sources, align = "lrrr",
  caption = paste("Sources of variation in a feature's SHAP attribution"))
```
Prediction-driven movement and reallocation. The first two numeric columns below should agree as the attribution total moves with the prediction. Reallocation share is the share of attribution variance that leaves the policy's total unchanged. 

```{r tab-reallocation}
decompose_sources <- function(l) {
  a <- arr_of(l); p <- dim(a)[2]
  s <- apply(a, c(1, 3), sum)                                  # attribution total per policy and replicate
  zero_sum <- a
  for (j in seq_len(p)) zero_sum[, j, ] <- a[, j, ] - s / p    # zero-sum (reallocation) part
  c(total_sd = mean(apply(s, 1, sd)),
    realloc_share = mean(apply(zero_sum, c(1, 2), var)) / mean(apply(a, c(1, 2), var)))
}
dec_refit <- t(sapply(models_b, function(m) decompose_sources(stab$phi_refit[[m]])))
dec_noise <- t(sapply(models_b, function(m) decompose_sources(stab$noise_phi[[m]])))
realloc <- data.frame(
  Model = as.character(lab(models_b)),
  `Prediction SD across refits`               = sprintf("%.3f", stab$stab_axis2$pred_sd[ix2]),
  `Attribution-total SD across refits`        = sprintf("%.3f", dec_refit[, "total_sd"]),
  `Profile distance, refits`                  = sprintf("%.3f", stab$stab_axis2$profile_tv[ix2]),
  `Profile distance, explainer noise`         = sprintf("%.3f", stab$stab_axis1$profile_tv[ix1]),
  `Reallocation share, refits`                = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * dec_refit[, "realloc_share"]),
  `Reallocation share, explainer noise`       = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * dec_noise[, "realloc_share"]),
  check.names = FALSE)
themed_table(realloc, align = "lrrrrrr",
  caption = paste("Prediction-driven movement and reallocation"))
```

```{r feature-data}
feats_all <- colnames(stab$phi_refit$GLM[[1]])
feature_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models_b, function(m) {
  v_refit <- colMeans(cell_var(stab$phi_refit[[m]]))
  v_noise <- colMeans(cell_var(stab$noise_phi[[m]]))
  data.frame(model = m, feature = feats_all, refit_pct = pct(sqrt(v_refit)), floor_pct = pct(sqrt(v_noise)),
             share_of_refit_variance = 100 * v_refit / sum(v_refit))
}))
ann_order <- feature_tab$feature[feature_tab$model == "ANN_selected"][
  order(feature_tab$refit_pct[feature_tab$model == "ANN_selected"])]
feature_tab$feature <- factor(feature_tab$feature, levels = ann_order)
feature_tab$lab <- lab(feature_tab$model)
```

Share of refit variance in SHAP attributions contributed by each feature.

```{r tab-features}
wide_share <- reshape(feature_tab[, c("model", "feature", "share_of_refit_variance")],
                      idvar = "feature", timevar = "model", direction = "wide")
wide_share <- wide_share[order(-wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.ANN_selected), ]
themed_table(
  data.frame(Feature = as.character(wide_share$feature),
             GLM = sprintf("%.0f%%", wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.GLM),
             GBM = sprintf("%.0f%%", wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.GBM_selected),
```

Standard deviation of each feature's SHAP attribution across refits (premium-equivalent), by model; black ticks mark the explainer-noise floor for the same model.
```{r fig-features, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Standard deviation of each feature's SHAP attribution across refits"}
ggplot(feature_tab, aes(x = refit_pct, y = feature, fill = lab)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = floor_pct, xend = floor_pct,
                   y = as.numeric(feature) - 0.4, yend = as.numeric(feature) + 0.4),
               linewidth = 0.9) +

```
Standard deviation of SHAP attributions across refits (premium-equivalent) by predicted-risk decile (1 = lowest) and model.
```{r fig-deciles, fig.cap = "Standard deviation of SHAP attributions across refits"}
n_pol <- nrow(stab$phi_refit$GLM[[1]])
dec_of_policy <- rep(1:10, each = n_pol / 10)       # the stability sample is stored in equal blocks by decile
by_decile <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models_b, function(m) {
  v <- rowMeans(cell_var(stab$phi_refit[[m]]))
  data.frame(model = m, decile = 1:10, refit_pct = pct(sqrt(tapply(v, dec_of_policy, mean))))
}))
by_decile$lab <- lab(by_decile$model)
ggplot(by_decile, aes(x = decile, y = refit_pct, colour = lab, shape = lab, linetype = lab, group = lab)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) + scale_model() +
  labs(x = "Predicted-risk decile (1 = lowest)", y = "SD of attribution across refits (premium-equivalent, %)") +
  base_theme
```
